finding.headline: "The Baby-Cries-When-I-Cook Mama"
finding.problem: "I put her down to cook and she screams like I'm abandoning her. I end up holding her and crying, with nothing made."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"
finding.person: A 27-yr-old mum whose baby screams the second she's put down; she can't chop, stir and soothe at once; dinner never happens.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "Cook With Baby On You: 18 One-Pot, Babywearing-Safe Meals." (cite Reddit bouncer hack)". Verdict: PASSES (20/25)..
